mapper.sql: status_id AS statusId, group_key AS groupKey, modifier_id AS modifierId, attr_key AS attrKey, modifier_mode AS modifierMode, value, formula_id AS formulaId, bucket_key AS bucketKey, per_stack AS perStack, priority, extend::text AS extendJson
mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.status_attribute_modifiers WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY status_id, group_key, priority, modifier_id
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.status_attribute_modifiers (game_id, status_id, group_key, modifier_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, attr_key, modifier_mode, value, formula_id, bucket_key, per_stack, priority, extend, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{statusId}, #{groupKey}, #{modifierId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{attrKey}, #{modifierMode}, #{value}, #{formulaId}, #{bucketKey}, #{perStack}, #{priority}, COALESCE(CAST(#{extendJson} AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, status_id, group_key, modifier_id) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, attr_key = EXCLUDED.attr_key, modifier_mode = EXCLUDED.modifier_mode, value = EXCLUDED.value, formula_id = EXCLUDED.formula_id, bucket_key = EXCLUDED.bucket_key, per_stack = EXCLUDED.per_stack, priority = EXCLUDED.priority, extend = EXCLUDED.extend, updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO public.status_attribute_modifiers_log (game_id, status_id, group_key, modifier_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, attr_key, modifier_mode, value, formula_id, bucket_key, per_stack, priority, extend) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{statusId}, #{groupKey}, #{modifierId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{attrKey}, #{modifierMode}, #{value}, #{formulaId}, #{bucketKey}, #{perStack}, #{priority}, COALESCE(CAST(#{extendJson} AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (game_id, status_id, group_key, modifier_id, start_version_id) DO UPDATE SET end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, attr_key = EXCLUDED.attr_key, modifier_mode = EXCLUDED.modifier_mode, value = EXCLUDED.value, formula_id = EXCLUDED.formula_id, bucket_key = EXCLUDED.bucket_key, per_stack = EXCLUDED.per_stack, priority = EXCLUDED.priority, extend = EXCLUDED.extend
